scope: Saved structured result/model/validation outputs, measured CSV rows and selected terminal summaries. No experiments, model regeneration or scientific replay executed. Historical status remains dated; later corrections are in the individual catalogue.
privacy: No raw secret key, ciphertext, full observed phase, weighted-mask aggregate, biometric vector or subject identity is intentionally distributed. CSV columns retain measurement/control classification only. Source and copy hashes and field transformations are explicit.
recalculation_limit: Measured CSV rows and retained aggregate counts permit recomputing descriptive comparisons/checking count consistency. Redacted validation JSON is not a substitute for private raw-phase replay. Selected terminal summaries are recorded outputs, not fresh validation.
